about: Manifest line and finish contracts. A malformed ordinary line remains a typed BadLine; finishing returns all data accumulated by line steps.

mutants.name: nou-end-loses-result
mutants.rule: Finish returns the accumulated manifest, including the project's requirements, through the narrow callable contract.

mutants.name: nou-step-suppresses-reject
mutants.from: BadLine{No: l.No, Text: l.Text, Reason: "a needs line belongs under a project or package line"}
mutants.rule: A needs line before the first project/package is a typed BadLine with the original line number, not an ignored line.
